recognize_zh: 單顆母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞核右上方有一個清楚的淡染凹陷，使核呈杯狀（cup-shaped，魚嘴樣）；標題所述 Auer 小體在此解析度下僅見凹陷區可疑的淡線狀構造，不易確認。
features: Single intermediate-to-large blast, roughly 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with finely dispersed chromatin
Prominent pale cup-shaped nuclear invagination at one pole (fish-mouth appearance), occupying well over a quarter of the nuclear diameter
Scant pale cytoplasm; a possible faint linear inclusion in the invagination, but a definite Auer rod is not clearly resolved
Background normochromic red cells without other nucleated cells in field; image slightly out of focus
describe_en: Smear shows a single blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a prominent pale cup-shaped nuclear invagination giving a fish-mouth appearance. The surrounding cytoplasm is scant, and a definite Auer rod cannot be confidently identified at this focus and resolution, although a faint linear structure may be present within the invagination. No other nucleated cells are in the field. Findings are consistent with a cup-like blast, a morphology associated with AML with NPM1 mutation and/or FLT3-ITD; molecular testing is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or reniform folded nuclei with fine granules and occasional faggot cells, and PML::RARA testing separates it.
Monocytic cells have folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm rather than a sharply demarcated clear invagination.
Cup-like invaginations can rarely be seen in ALL, and the absence of a convincing Auer rod means immunophenotyping (MPO, cCD3, CD19) is needed to assign lineage.

ddx.dx: Artifactual nuclear indentation from overlying red cell
ddx.vs: An overlying red cell produces a pink-tinged circular overlap rather than a clear pale invagination within the nucleus.
